mechanism_of_action.plain_language: Cemacabtagene ansegedleucel is an allogeneic CAR T-cell therapy targeting CD19, designed to enhance the immune response against CD19-expressing malignancies.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: The therapy utilizes genetically modified T-cells to express a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that targets the CD19 antigen on B-cell malignancies.

clinical_settings: Consolidation therapy for MRD+ remission in LBCL
Treatment for relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma

data_notes.record_scope: Cemacabtagene ansegedleucel is currently in clinical trials for specific hematological malignancies.
